posts.text: We just closed our seed round. $4.2M led by Initialized with participation from a bunch of operators we've been learning from for years. Wild day. Now the actual work starts.
Hiring our first GTM hire. Looking for someone who's done outbound at a seed-stage B2B SaaS startup before. If you've sent 1000+ cold emails and lived to tell the tale, DM me.
Spent the morning going through our outbound tool. Honestly cannot believe how generic the AI suggestions are. 'I noticed you're a CEO!' Yes. So is half my list. This is not personalization.
Reading 'The Mom Test' for the third time. Different book at every stage.
